systems.tiers: Policy target of at least one multiservice telecentre per commune in 2015
Policy target to deploy the main national broadband infrastructure down to commune level before 2015; no commune office is said to be on it

note: Passages only. National ICT policy 2010-2025, adopted 13 July 2011: its commune-level targets are a telecentre per commune and a backbone reaching commune level, both noted classes, plus in-service ICT training of staff in local authorities (capacity); it sets no target for connecting commune offices in the passages given, so no fact.
